qa_pairs.question: What steps should I take before contacting AllianceCan support?
qa_pairs.answer: Before writing to AllianceCan support, it's advisable to first check the system status page (https://status.computecanada.ca) to see if the issue you're experiencing has already been reported. Additionally, make sure that the email address you are using to send your message is registered in your account (https://ccdb.computecanada.ca/email) to enable automatic recognition by the ticketing system.

qa_pairs.question: What are the best practices for crafting an effective subject line for a support email to AllianceCan?
qa_pairs.answer: To craft an effective subject line for a support email to AllianceCan, you should include the system or cluster name and a few words describing the problem. For example, 'Job 123456 fails to run on the Rorqual cluster' is a good subject line that helps identify issues at a glance.

qa_pairs.question: How should I determine which email address to use when contacting AllianceCan support?
qa_pairs.answer: To contact AllianceCan support, you should choose the email address that best corresponds to your specific question or issue. For instance, use `accounts@tech.alliancecan.ca` for account questions, `globus@tech.alliancecan.ca` for Globus file transfer services, or `support@tech.alliancecan.ca` for any other general questions or issues.
